offering_description.value: Makes medical, dental and infection prevention products, plus health information software and documentation services. It sells mainly to hospitals, clinics, dental practices and healthcare providers, and delivers products through manufacturing and sales channels, with software and services delivered to providers.

primary_products.value: medical tapes and wound dressings; infection prevention products; dental aligners and restorative materials; medical coding software; clinical documentation software

primary_services.value: clinical documentation and transcription services; medical coding services; health information technology support

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, health systems, clinics, dental practices and health insurers

end_markets.value: healthcare; dental care; health information technology

revenue_model.value: product sales: medical, dental and infection prevention products sold to providers; subscription: software licenses and subscriptions for coding and documentation tools; service fees: transcription and medical coding services for providers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes medical, dental and infection prevention products, sold to providers and distributors; software / platform: health information software sold to hospitals and clinics; service provider: documentation and coding services sold to healthcare providers
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; software / platform; service provider

geography_served.value: global: US and many countries worldwide, including Europe and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: diversified: medical products, dental solutions and health information systems serving different customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: hospitals, health systems and large dental groups; distributors / dealers: medical and dental supply distributors; partners / resellers: dental and healthcare channel partners
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: medical and dental devices needing FDA clearance and EU medical device approval, health data privacy rules such as HIPAA

notes: Purification and filtration business may have been sold and is not described here.
